//: Shipped to consumers as `open-ocpp-tck/tsconfig`, so that writing a driver
does not start with an afternoon of compilerOptions archaeology.
compilerOptions ONLY. No `include`, no `files`, no `paths`: relative paths
in an extended config resolve relative to THIS file, which lives inside
node_modules -- an `include` here would silently try to compile the
package instead of the consumer's driver.
`moduleResolution: bundler` is the supported baseline. node16/nodenext
reject the extensionless relative imports in the generated declarations;
node10 ignores the exports map entirely and cannot resolve this package at
all. Both are documented in the README rather than papered over.
